subject: Scheduling ML/Infra deep dive — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Alejandra Ramos <alejandra@novacare.com>, Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + proposed next step: ML/Infra deep dive

Hi Alejandra / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great context on NovaCare's batch transcription and downstream triage use cases. Quick recap of what I heard:
- ~1.2M tokens/day ingestion from calls + batch upload
- Tight 200–400ms per-request latency target for live triage calls
- Data residency concerns for PHI in the EU (we discussed Private deployment options)

Per our call, the best next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML/Infra engineers to:
1) map your current pipeline and expected peak concurrency
2) validate latency and KV cache strategies for live requests
3) lock a recommended model/quantization profile and rollout plan

Availability from our side: Friday 5/21 between 10:00–14:00 PT or Monday 5/24 morning PT. I pasted a draft agenda and a quick readout of discovery notes as attachments.

Proposed agenda (draft):
- 5m introductions + objective
- 20m current infra & data flow (NovaCare)
- 30m latency/capacity modelling (Redwood leads)
- 20m recommended deployment & rollout plan + Qs
- 10m next steps & owners

Would either 5/21 10:30 PT or 5/24 9:00 PT work for you? If not, send a couple windows and I’ll coordinate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
[Attachment: NovaCare-discovery-notes.pdf]
[Attachment: TDX-proposed-agenda.md]

From: Alejandra Ramos <alejandra@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed next step: ML/Infra deep dive

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. 10:30 on 5/21 PT works for me. I'll confirm with Tom (he owns infra) but he's usually available that slot.

Couple of items to add to the agenda:
- Short section on compliance requirements (we need to confirm PHI handling in the private deployment)
- A brief look at integration touchpoints with our ingestion service (S3, Fargate microservice)

I’ll loop Tom in; if anything changes I’ll let you know by EOD tomorrow.

— Alejandra
Head of AI Products, NovaCare
alejandra@novacare.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Alejandra Ramos <alejandra@novacare.com>, Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed next step: ML/Infra deep dive

Thanks Alejandra — looping in Nikhil (infra lead) and Ben (solutions engineer) from our side to make sure we cover the PHI & ingestion integration items.

Nikhil / Ben — quick context: NovaCare is targeting both hosted and private options; they need a validated latency profile for live triage and clarity on PHI handling for a potential private control plane. Alejandra tentatively confirmed 5/21 10:30 PT. Can you both join?

Nikhil — can you bring a short slide (5–7 min) on our Private deployment controls (KMS, audit logs, network patterns) and any prerequisites you’d want from NovaCare?
Ben — can you prepare a simple diagram showing how Redwood would sit between S3 ingestion and the triage microservice (help us confirm integration work)?

If we lock 5/21 10:30 PT I’ll send the calendar invite and a brief pre-read with the discovery notes attached.

Thanks —
Marissa
[Sent from Redwood Console]

From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Alejandra Ramos <alejandra@novacare.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed next step: ML/Infra deep dive

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 9:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Nikhil / Ben — quick context: NovaCare is targeting both hosted and private options; they need a validated latency profile for live triage and clarity on PHI handling for a potential private control plane. Alejandra tentatively confirmed 5/21 10:30 PT. Can you both join?

That slot is good for me. I also want to add: we have an internal performance test harness that can produce a representative request shape; if Redwood can run a short capacity simulation during the deep dive (or in a quick follow-up runbook) that would be very helpful.

Also, can you confirm whether the Private control plane supports customer-managed KMS (we use AWS KMS) and whether logs can be forwarded to our SIEM (Splunk)? Happy to put the specific questions in a doc for the meeting.

— Tom
Director of Engineering, NovaCare
[Attachment: nova-performance-profile.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>

Great — locking 5/21 10:30–11:45 PT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tdx-novacare-20270521

Pre-read attached (discovery notes) and a single-sheet checklist for what we’ll need on the call:
- point-of-contact + AWS account id for private tests (if applicable)
- representative request traces / performance harness (Tom mentioned attaching)
- any listing of regulatory constraints you want us to address up-front

Nikhil / Ben — plan is to present the Private deployment capabilities and the integration diagram; allocate ~40 minutes for capacity/latency discussion and 15 minutes for Q&A.

If anyone needs to reschedule, please reply quickly — otherwise we’ll treat the time as confirmed. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Marissa
